scope: RuneScape: Dragonwilds, Scorned Wilderness raid (Kuldra) speedrun: people with insight
sources: YouTube comments on 42 raid videos via yt-dlp (1,415 comments)
speedrun.com API (users, runs, run comments, rules)
Twitch VOD/clip listings (heartlessedly, iNanobit, shadowstalkertm, archy2cold, superstooob)
not_reachable: Whisper transcription (mkl_malloc failure; zyneater 1Q21XYSKJgo guide and heartlessedly VODs untranscribed)
scoring: insight_score 0-100 = value for beating the 6:50 on the current patch: concrete technique/timing/patch info, corroboration by runners, being the original finder; likes are a minor factor.

people.name: Nanobit
people.summary: Holds the 1.0.1/1.0.1.1 run (7:01, SRC #2). His pinned comment lists ~25 timestamped time saves and he explains the zoop mechanics. He says the current route can "approach mid 6's". Most generous source; he points everyone to the RSDW Discord.

people.name: IINo1goodII
people.summary: Console player and the strongest post-1.0.1.2 lead. He claims "Kuldra skipped in 4 mins 40 seconds" by launching past the 3rd checkpoint, plunging past the patched rocks and surge-dashing the bridge, and says sub-4:30 is possible. He hides the full method. He found the Keep hole and elemental-puzzle skip used in the 7:01, and launches reliably with fall-damage cancelling. No SRC account.

people.name: Dotxy
people.summary: Found the 1.0.1 movement tech the current route depends on: dive/plunge (jump-attack) cancel on 10-14 and infinite double jump ("sanctum flight") on 10-21. His 1.0.1.2 Kuldra skip video has the exact inputs. He says a macro is not against the rules for single player. He also holds several glitchless Agility Course WRs.

people.name: TexasPete
people.summary: Holds the record: 6:50.000 on SRC, recorded 10/14 on routes that are now dead (Keep skip, the rocks to Kuldra). He contributed zoop routing (surge off ledges), the Stronghold jump and the melee heart. His commentary is mostly hype; the useful material is in his replies and SRC comments. His YouTube channel is otherwise pitbike racing.

people.name: Sir_Rebral
people.summary: Most precise route-detail commenter. He found the Garou Thane walking through the bars (an air charge without the rat room), the charge-pad edge trick that keeps elementals from spawning, the surge+dash into an invisible wall that unlocks a lodestone, and the faster necromancer route. He relayed SectorTSWG's Fragments skip to Nanobit and quotes Jagex's reddit post.

people.name: SamFPlays
people.summary: The most-watched guide maker (50K/31K/22K views). His voice-guided walkthroughs credit other finders. They cover the surge+phase-dash combo, gear (Fleet Foot infusion, Strong Tea, 2H staff, mace for the Thane) and where to stand at the heart so worms don't spawn. His replies are the best help for console players. He has not run since about 10-20 (doing OSRS).

people.name: SectorTSWG
people.summary: Found the post-1.0.1 skip to Fragments of Ghornfell next to the first black dragon. It reached Nanobit's 7:01 via Sir_Rebral, and the narrated video explains it. He also reported the earlier 1.0.1 invisible walls.

people.name: notmusty1
people.summary: Found the post-1.0.1 elemental puzzle skip, the Keep hole credited in Nanobit's 7:01 (independently of IINo1goodII), and a full Abyssal Demon skip. Nanobit thinks the demon skip is slower than the normal route. He says he is "really not a speedrunner".

people.name: Wes (ChiefWes)
people.summary: Found the rib clip: jump on the bone at the Kuldra checkpoint and swing a sword to clip back into the map. TexasPete and Nanobit both use and credit it. He set an early 9:37/9:43 "WR". Thelastiger re-uploaded his run with a claimed co-ownership.

people.name: FastTipsGaming
people.summary: Console guide maker. On 10-27 he showed the boss skip still works on 1.0.1.2 by flying "down the middle", and he says every rock and even the bridge was patched. On 11-02 he posted a full unedited raid with the skip. He warns that an autosave mid-trick kills you. Dotxy accused him of not crediting the original video.

people.name: CrossRSDW
people.summary: First widely seen raid-skip guides (9/21, 10/01). Useful diagnostics: if you hit an invisible barrier during the Kuldra dash you are too high, and the green crystals have an insta-kill barrier. He credits Tiger with the Bars (Zilko's find) for the original Kuldra skip. He now runs a Dragonwilds podcast that has nothing on the raid.

people.name: Trance_OCE
people.summary: Destiny 2 speedrunner. He suggests testing whether zoop distance depends on FPS, gaining height to zoop past the Keep jumping puzzle, and starting in Leggings of Lightness then hot-swapping instead of learning the plunge tech. He "guarantee[s]" sub 5.

people.name: koltplan
people.summary: Practised the Vines-to-Fragments max zoop for a sub-7 attempt and gives hard consistency numbers: about 1 in 50 attempts, and 5/400. That is the best evidence that the zoop is a lottery as currently understood.

people.name: heartlessedly
people.summary: Pre-1.0.0.6 runs (5:02, then 3:57, the former WR, both patched). He says "New rules require one single run as death warps should not work". That rule is not in the written SRC Raid rules, so it may be a Discord or mod decision. He has two long Twitch VODs of route testing from September.

people.name: ShadowStalkerTM
people.summary: 3:27 pre-1.0.0.6 raid record using extraction/checkpoint unlocks, all patched. His replies describe how those extraction unlocks behaved inconsistently. He has a Dragonwilds safespot guide and a "skip regions" video. Twitch only has old shooter clips.

people.name: zyneater
people.summary: Destiny 2 raid-cheese creator. Made an 18-minute narrated 1.0.1 raid guide (no captions; whisper failed here). He says there is "a better route directly to the first air anima vent" and that "edge boost surges" can make the necro gap without a death warp. He thinks the necromancer staff beats the ancestral staff.

people.name: loopuleasa
people.summary: PC input optimisation: Q+number spell keybinds work mid-air. He reports that alt+f4 now saves the game, which conflicts with Nanobit's force-close reset practice trick. He also quotes a J-Mod on reddit saying skips will be fixed.

people.name: Dokmix
people.summary: Gave the clearest skip-by-skip status list right after 1.0.1. SamFPlays used it to find the air anima workaround.

people.name: brendonboyd7668
people.summary: PS5 button mapping and a learning progression for infinite flight.

people.name: PickemFantasyFootball
people.summary: PS5 input loop for the flight cycle (R2-triangle-L2-L2-X). He asks whether the 2:41 gap in FastTips' run can be surge/phase-dashed to the extraction node.

people.name: Channel Xero
people.summary: A 1.0.1 raid skip guide (5.6K views) and surge/dash ordering tips. He predicts the wandering Garou Thane will be patched.

people.name: funkybasic
people.summary: Agility Course WR holder. TexasPete credits him for movement strats. His run notes describe surge edge jumps (zoops), autowalk headstarts and construction manipulations. He has not run the raid.

people.name: Nimblesk
people.summary: 8:28 on 1.0.0.8 (SRC #3). Confirms the "too high -> blocked" behaviour on the Kuldra jump.

people.name: AryVT
people.summary: Duo trick: a player who died rejoins with ~4 s left to unlock the Kuldra teleport and loop the boss. It is for farming and multiplayer only, not the solo SRC Raid category.

people.name: Zilko
people.summary: Credited as the original finder of the legacy Kuldra fight skip (windstep up the floating rocks to the heart). That skip was patched in 1.0.1.2. He has no public videos or comments of his own; only Tiger with the Bars' upload credits him. The SRC account "Zilko" exists but has no runs and may not be the same person. He may be reachable via Discord (".zilko").
